dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #{F#Big sis}{M#Big bro}, you're really good at this! You even cracked my "Kujirai Art, Temari Jutsu."

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: If you are looking for the Temari, you need to find the Temari hidden by others within the time limit and you win.

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: If you are hiding the Temari, you must hide the Temari within the same limited time. It's only fair to the player looking for it. The Big Sister adventurer said that fairness in the game is very important!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Ah, it's a school of martial arts that we created ourselves with Grandpa Shousen's advice. The aim was to develop invincible martial arts using the Temari.

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: If we can use various methods to blast enemies away with explosive Temari, then we can win without even fighting!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's very sure that that's not how you play Temari...

choices.text: How many people are there in the Kujirai family?

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Besides my mom and dad, we have an eldest sister, named Momiji. She used to play with us a lot.

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: But ever since she got hooked on fishing, she won't play with us anymore. And she even says we'll scare the fish away!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Then... how many brothers do I have? Honestly, I'm not too sure either...

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: She's a very powerful Big Sister adventurer!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: She taught us how to play Temari, how to sing the Temari song, and how to use the Temari to blow up the bad guys!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: When she left, she said she was going somewhere far, far away to do something very important.

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: That's why we have to study "Temari Jutsu" and help her in future!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: #Bye-bye, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}! Help me say hello if you see my brothers and sister!
